earnings.title: Dell Technologies Delivers Second Quarter Fiscal 2027 Financial Results
highlights: Record revenue of $47.0 billion, up 58% year over year
Record diluted earnings per share (EPS) of $6.34, up 273% year over year, and record non-GAAP diluted EPS of $7.04, up 203%
Cash flow from operations of $2.2 billion
Record revenue: $31.8 billion, up 89% year over year
Record AI-Optimized Servers revenue: $16.4 billion, up 100% year over year

quotes.text: IT environments have shifted from cost centers to value drivers that fuel growth and competitive advantage, and customers are investing accordingly – creating opportunity across our portfolio.
quotes.by: Jeff Clarke, vice chairman and chief operating officer, Dell Technologies

quotes.text: In our second quarter, we delivered record revenue of $47 billion, record EPS and a record $4.3 billion returned to shareholders.
quotes.by: David Kennedy, chief financial officer, Dell Technologies

outlook: Full-year FY27 revenue guidance of $192.0 billion, up 69% year over year
Full-year FY27 EPS guidance of $24.37 and non-GAAP EPS guidance of $25.50, up 181% and 148% year over year, respectively
